title: Ruin
author: Gwynne, John
review:
This book is absolutely epic in every way, the number of POVs has increased steadily from the first book and you get to see all sides of the conflict in interesting ways. There's some great character moments that have been building throughout the series and finally pay off here and some twists that you don't see coming.

This one has one of the best duels I've ever read and multiple large scale battles that are all distinct from one-another, Gwynne does action sequences exceptionally well and they're easy to visualize what exactly is going on.
